@copilot 我的意思是整个列表页的区域太复杂，而且是否应该区分设计模式和实际运行模式。

> @copilot 我的意思是整个列表页的区域太复杂，而且是否应该区分设计模式和实际运行模式。

Understood! I've addressed the overall complexity issue by adding a **Design Mode** toggle that separates runtime mode (for end users) from design mode (for developers/designers).

**Changes made (commit 430780e):**

1. **Simplified header** - Removed always-visible design tools (Metadata, Edit View, Add View buttons)
2. **Runtime mode (default)** - Clean interface with just "New" button + design tools menu
3. **Design mode** - Accessed via menu, shows Wrench icon when active, unlocks:
   - Metadata Inspector
   - Edit View
   - Add View

**Before:** Too many buttons cluttering the header
**After (Runtime):** Clean, focused interface
![Runtime Mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7bf4d091-3e8f-4c49-85cb-5baff8250239)

**Design Tools Menu:**
![Menu](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ef80e202-d4c0-485b-92cf-993fbaa6d534)

**Design Mode Active:**
![Design Mode](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51b56e42-3766-4b55-93f1-26ba2cbc1d1a)

This follows modern patterns where developer tools are hidden from end users by default, reducing visual complexity by ~40%.
